reason: Fresh QA exposed that the frozen visual direction assumed a pre-submit disabled state which the host business does not have. The host intentionally allows submit to surface validation errors.

stateMapping.incompleteBeforeSubmit: active control; clicking produces existing validation feedback
stateMapping.invalidAfterSubmit: error feedback is visible and associated with the unchanged active publish action
stateMapping.submitting: disabled/loading styling and semantics only if this real host state exists

qaCorrection: Absence of a pre-submit disabled state is N/A, not a failure, when validation-on-submit is proven.
